<style>

        /* New Warm & Elegant Theme Colors */
        :root {
            --bg-color: #f4f1ee; /* Warm Off-White */
            --text-color: #5a5349; /* Warm Gray/Brown Body Text */
            --heading-color: #4a433a; /* Darker Warm Gray/Brown Headings */
            --accent-color: #8b8173; /* Muted Khaki/Taupe Accent */
            --font-serif: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
            --font-sans: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;

            /* Existing non-color variables kept for structure */
            --shadow-subtle: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
            --border-radius: 12px;
        }

        /* General Styles */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-sans);
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            color: var(--text-color);
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        .container {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0 20px;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        h1, h2, h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-serif);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-top: 0;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        p {
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        b, strong {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        section {
            padding: 60px 0;
        }
        
        /* --- Hero Section --- */
        .hero-section {
            background-image: url('/img/bbb4.avif'); 
            background-size: cover;
            background-position: center center;
            position: relative; 
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 400px;
            color: var(--bg-color);
            padding: 80px 20px 60px;
            border-bottom-left-radius: 40px;
            border-bottom-right-radius: 40px;
            text-align: center;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        
        .hero-section::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            z-index: 2;
        }
        
        .hero-section .container {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 3;
        }

        .hero-section h1 {
            font-size: clamp(30px, 5.5vw, 54px);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            color: var(--bg-color);
            text-shadow: none;
        }

        /* --- Content & Philosophy --- */
        .content-wrap {
            padding: 40px 0;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .intro-text, .philosophy-box {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .intro-text h2 {
            font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 36px);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
            line-height: 1.25;
        }
        .philosophy-box {
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-color);
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .philosophy-box h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .philosophy-box p {
            font-style: italic;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-color);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .philosophy-box p:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        /* --- Services Grid --- */
        .services-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 30px;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .service-card {
            background-color: #ffffff;
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }
        .service-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        }
        .service-card h3 {
            font-size: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .service-card p {
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .service-card p:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
        .service-card ul {
            padding-left: 20px;
            margin: 10px 0;
        }
        .service-card li {
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }

        /* --- Why Choose Us --- */
        .why-choose-us {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .why-choose-us h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .why-choose-intro {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto 30px;
            font-size: 16px;
        }
        .why-choose-intro p {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .reason-list {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 0;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }
        .reason-list li {
            background: #ffffff;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            border-left: 5px solid var(--accent-color);
            font-size: 15px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
        }
        .reason-list strong {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .final-cta-message {
            margin-top: 30px;
            text-align: center;
            font-style: italic;
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .final-cta-message a {
            color: var(--accent-color);
            text-decoration: underline;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* --- FAQ Section --- */
        .faq-section {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .faq-section h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .faq-list {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .faq-item {
            background-color: #ffffff;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .faq-q {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .faq-a {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--text-color);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin: 0;
        }

        /* Learn More Button */
        .learn-more-wrap {
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 35px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .learn-more-btn {
            display: inline-block;
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 14px 38px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(139, 129, 115, 0.3);
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .learn-more-btn:hover {
            background-color: var(--heading-color);
            color: #ffffff;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(74, 67, 58, 0.4);
        }

        /* --- Closing Section --- */
        .closing-section {
            padding: 40px;
            background-color: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            margin-top: 30px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .closing-section h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .closing-section p {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto 15px;
            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }
        .closing-section p a {
            color: var(--accent-color);
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        /* --- Work Done / Project Showcase Gallery Carousel --- */
        .work-gallery-section {
            margin-top: 50px;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .gallery-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 35px;
            padding: 0 20px;
        }
        .gallery-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 36px);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .gallery-header p {
            font-size: 16px;
            max-width: 750px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper {
            width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            padding: 15px 0 25px;
            -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 4%, black 96%, transparent);
            mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 4%, black 96%, transparent);
        }
        .gallery-carousel-track {
            display: flex;
            width: max-content;
            animation: infiniteGalleryScroll 30s linear infinite;
            will-change: transform;
        }
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper:hover .gallery-carousel-track,
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper:active .gallery-carousel-track {
            animation-play-state: paused;
        }
        .gallery-carousel-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 25px;
            padding-right: 25px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gallery-card {
            width: 320px;
            max-width: 340px;
            background-color: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 129, 115, 0.2);
            transition: transform 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease, border-color 0.35s ease;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gallery-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
            border-color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .gallery-img-wrap {
            width: 100%;
            height: 240px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            background-color: #e5e0d8;
            border-radius: inherit;
        }
        .gallery-img-wrap img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
            transition: transform 0.6s ease;
        }
        .gallery-card:hover .gallery-img-wrap img {
            transform: scale(1.08);
        }
        @keyframes infiniteGalleryScroll {
            0% {
                transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translate3d(-25%, 0, 0);
            }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .gallery-carousel-track {
                animation: none;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-wrapper {
                overflow-x: auto;
                -webkit-mask-image: none;
                mask-image: none;
            }
        }        /* Mobile Responsiveness */
        @media (max-width: 767px) {
            .hero-section {
                padding: 60px 16px 40px;
                border-radius: 0;
            }
            .content-wrap.container {
                padding-left: 0;
                padding-right: 0;
                padding-top: 25px;
                padding-bottom: 25px;
            }
            .intro-text {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                max-width: 100%;
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                margin-bottom: 35px;
            }
            .intro-text h2 {
                font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 6.5vw, 2.1rem);
                line-height: 1.22;
                margin-bottom: 16px;
            }
            .intro-text p {
                font-size: 16px;
                line-height: 1.7;
                margin-bottom: 15px;
            }
            .philosophy-box {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                max-width: 100%;
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                padding: 26px 16px;
                border-radius: 16px;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                overflow: hidden;
                margin-bottom: 40px;
            }
            .philosophy-box h2 {
                margin: 0 0 22px;
                text-align: center;
                font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 7vw, 2.25rem);
                line-height: 1.18;
                overflow-wrap: break-word;
            }
            .philosophy-box p {
                width: 100%;
                margin: 0 0 20px;
                padding: 0;
                text-align: left;
                text-indent: 0;
                font-size: 17px;
                line-height: 1.7;
                overflow-wrap: break-word;
                word-break: normal;
                hyphens: none;
            }
            .philosophy-box p:last-child {
                margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            .services-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 20px;
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                margin-bottom: 40px;
            }
            .why-choose-us,
            .faq-section {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
            }
            .gallery-card {
                width: 280px;
            }
            .gallery-img-wrap {
                height: 200px;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-group {
                gap: 18px;
                padding-right: 18px;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-track {
                animation-duration: 22s;
            }
            .closing-section {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                padding: 25px 16px;
                border-radius: 16px;
            }
            .process-card-row {
                flex-direction: column;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 767px) {
            .intro-text,
            .philosophy-box,
            .services-grid,
            .why-choose-us,
            .faq-section,
            .closing-section {
                width: calc(100% - 40px);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <section class="hero-section">
        <div class="container">
            <h1>Top Interior Design Firm in Delhi</h1>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- MAIN CONTENT WRAPPER -->
    <div class="container content-wrap">

        <!-- INTRO -->
        <div class="intro-text">
            <h2>Top Interior Design Firm for Practical and Well-Planned Spaces</h2>
            <p>An interior designed thoughtfully can significantly influence how individuals feel about a location. Designing an interior is beyond simply picking fashionable pieces of furniture and decoration. It involves making sure that there is enough space to walk around, good storage areas, and good lighting for different spaces. As a <b>Top Interior Design Firm in Delhi</b>, we work on homes, offices, showrooms, and commercial spaces with these practical needs in mind.</p>
            <p>As a top interior design firm, we begin the design work by talking to the client to find out about their needs. Each property has unique requirements. For instance, an individual building a new house may look for an easy-to-use and functional layout, while an office manager may want to ensure the office layout allows employees to do their work easily. What is more, before getting down to the design process, we will take into account such factors as space availability, budget, desired style, and purpose.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- PHILOSOPHY / SERVICE OVERVIEW -->
        <div class="philosophy-box">
            <h2>Balanced Interior Planning for Comfortable and Easy-to-Use Spaces</h2>
            <p>A room can look good without having furniture or decoration in every available corner. In fact, keeping some open area often makes the space easier to use and more comfortable.</p>
            <p>While planning an interior, a top interior design firm considers how the different elements will sit together. Furniture, storage, lighting, colours, wall finishes, and décor are chosen with the room in mind. Each part has its own purpose, but the overall space should still feel balanced and easy to use.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- SERVICE CATEGORIES GRID (4 CARDS) -->
        <div class="services-grid">
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Interiors Designed Around Your Home</h3>
                <p>Every home has its own way of being used. The needs of a family with children can be very different from those of someone living alone. The same goes for a spacious house and a smaller apartment, where every part of the available area may need to serve a purpose. A <b>Top Interior Design Firm in Delhi</b> understands these differences and plans each space around the way people actually live and use their homes.</p>
            </div>
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Luxury & Elegant Interiors</h3>
                <p>For a top interior design firm, it is essential to plan an elegant interior. Appropriate furniture, lighting, colors, materials, and decorations lead to a beautiful and harmonious interior.</p>
                <p>We develop <b>elegant interior designs</b> that correspond to the wishes of our clients and the interior style.</p>
                <p>For those who are looking for a <b>Luxury Home Interior Design Company in Delhi</b>, we aim to create not just a beautiful place but a comfortable home.</p>
            </div>
